questions.question: Which surface provides good traction?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings all reduce tire traction. Dry pavement provides the best traction for motorcycles.

questions.question: A person convicted of DUI may receive any of the following penalties except:

options.text: Installation of a breath-alcohol device in their vehicle.

questions.explanation: DUI penalties in Illinois include license suspension, installation of a breath-alcohol device, heavy fines, and community service. A warning is not a penalty for DUI.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does the body eliminate per hour?
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour on average. The time needed to lower blood alcohol content varies. Do not drive or ride after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: When riding at night, you should travel:

options.text: More slowly than you would during the day under similar conditions.
At the speed you would travel during the day under similar conditions.
Faster than you would during the day under similar conditions.
On the shoulder of the road so other vehicles can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: More slowly than you would during the day under similar conditions.
questions.explanation: Ride slower at night than during the day in similar conditions. Dark conditions make it harder to see hazards. Slower speeds help you avoid dangers.

questions.question: In Illinois, motorcycle safety helmets are:

options.text: Required for both operator and passenger.

questions.explanation: Illinois law does not require motorcycle helmets. However, wearing a properly-fitted helmet is strongly recommended.

questions.question: The best way to stop quickly is to use both brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes at the same time to stop quickly.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after having one alcoholic drink before riding:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and driving.
Alcohol will not affect your riding skills.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your riding ability even if you wait one hour.

questions.question: Motorcycle passengers must wear a helmet.
questions.explanation: Helmets reduce the risk of fatal head injuries, but Illinois law does not require them.

questions.question: The front brake is:

options.text: Only for use if the rear brake fails.

questions.explanation: The front brake is safe when used correctly. It provides at least three-fourths of your motorcycle's total stopping power.

questions.question: Which is not important when choosing a motorcycle helmet?

options.text: The helmet meets U.S. Department of Transportation standards.
The helmet fits snugly all around your head.
The helmet has no cracks or loose padding.

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards, fits snugly all around your head, and has no visible damage like cracks or loose padding. Appearance is not important for safety.

questions.question: Brightly-colored helmets:

options.text: Make it easier for others to see the wearer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make it easier for others to see the wearer.
questions.explanation: Brightly-colored helmets are recommended. They protect you in a crash and help other drivers see you on the road.

questions.question: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield:

options.text: Is not necessary if you have a windshield.

questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your entire face during a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield is not a good substitute for goggles or a face shield.

questions.question: The best way to stop quickly is to:

options.text: Reduce throttle and use the front brake.
Use both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply both brakes at once. Press firmly and do not panic if the brakes lock.

questions.question: Reflective clothing should:

options.text: Be worn only during the day.

questions.explanation: Brightly-colored and reflective clothing helps others see you in any conditions. Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day, so wear bright clothing day and night.

questions.question: Which fabric provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the most protection for motorcycle riders.
